chars.H: HAMZA: a man in his early 30s with a short neat black beard drawn on the chin, wearing a light-blue short-sleeve button shirt with a small white name badge on the chest pocket and dark grey trousers.
chars.W: WIFE: a young woman in her late 20s wearing a burgundy hijab and a long beige cardigan over a black ankle-length dress.
chars.R: FRIEND: a man in his early 30s, clean-shaven with curly black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black jeans.
chars.T: TECHNICIAN: a chubby man in his 30s with round glasses and a grey knitted beanie, wearing a dark green polo shirt.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a dim hallway doorway of a modest Casablanca apartment: in the bright Moroccan salon the WIFE and the FRIEND sit close together on the long low sofa, laughing loudly at something on a phone, faces clearly visible, head-to-waist framing, centred, the doorframe edge softly in the foreground.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Around a low round Moroccan table with a tagine at dinner: HAMZA eats in silence with a forced calm face, eyes lowered, while the WIFE and the FRIEND smile at each other across the table.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night on a small apartment balcony over Casablanca rooftops: HAMZA leans on the railing holding his forehead with one hand, worried and torn, face visible in the warm light from inside.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a bedroom HAMZA sits on the edge of the bed holding a framed family photo of himself, his wife and a tiny daughter, looking at it with sad, anxious eyes.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom at night: HAMZA lies awake on his back with his eyes wide open, staring at the ceiling, lit by the bluish glow of the phone in his hand, thinking hard.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Morning in a small Casablanca electronics shop with shelves full of security cameras and cables: HAMZA, tired with dark circles, leans over the counter talking seriously to the TECHNICIAN who listens carefully.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close view at the shop counter: the TECHNICIAN holds out a tiny black hidden camera, smaller than a matchbox, in his open palm; HAMZA looks at it with a determined, nervous face.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Outside the electronics shop on a Casablanca street: HAMZA holds his phone to his ear, faking a sick, weak voice with a hand on his throat, glancing sideways guiltily.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the shop the TECHNICIAN sets up an app on HAMZA's smartphone, pointing at the glowing screen (blank screen, no text) while HAMZA watches closely, the tiny camera lying on the counter between them.
